explainShare: A business paid you for an Instagram share.
explainReferral: Your share of Tagly's revenue from someone you referred.
explainAdjustment: A manual correction to your balance by the Tagly team.
explainProcessing: This money left your Tagly balance and is on its way to your bank. Transfers usually arrive within a few business days.
explainDelayed: Your bank couldn't accept this transfer, so the money is waiting safely in your Stripe account. Fix your bank details below and we'll send it again automatically.
explainPaidOut: This money arrived in your bank account.
explainFailed: This withdrawal couldn't start, so nothing left your account. The full amount is still in your Tagly balance and you can withdraw it again.
explainReversed: This transfer came back to us, so we returned the full amount to your Tagly balance. You can withdraw it again anytime.
